title: Smoked Chicken Wings
description: A simple and delicious recipe for smoked chicken wings that's perfect for a barbecue. The combination of smoked and quick-cooked wings creates a mouth-watering flavor.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken wings.
Place the wings in the smoker, close the lid, and smoke for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, increase the temperature to 300°F (150°C) and continue to cook for an additional 30 minutes.
While the wings are cooking, heat the quick barbecue sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the wings are done, toss them in the barbecue sauce until they're fully coated.
Serve the smoked chicken wings hot and enjoy!
